$comment: Hand maintained. exceptions: docs embeds from pubnub/kotlin that no test runs, each with a reason (path: the path in the url of the docs tag, ids absent means every embed of the path). one_sided: pages that exist in one docset only, with a reason. DocsToolsTest checks the shape and DocsCheck reads exceptions.

exceptions.reason: Whole-file resource embed, not code. Copied byte for byte to integrationTest/resources/com/pubnub/docs/logging/logback.xml. LoggingDocsTest loads it into logback and runs the logback sample through it. Listed because the manifest has no whole-file entries.

Whole-file resource embed, not code. Copied byte for byte to integrationTest/resources/com/pubnub/docs/logging/log4j2.xml. Log4j2 is not the SLF4J binding of the tests, so LoggingDocsTest only parses the file and checks the com.pubnub TRACE logger the docs describe.

Whole-file resource embed, not code. Copied byte for byte to integrationTest/resources/com/pubnub/docs/logging/simplelogger.properties. slf4j-simple is not the SLF4J binding of the tests, so LoggingDocsTest only loads the properties and checks the com.pubnub debug level the docs describe.

Android only: LogcatAppender (ch.qos.logback.classic.android) is not on the JVM classpath, so the file cannot be loaded into logback. Copied byte for byte to integrationTest/resources/com/pubnub/docs/logging/android/logback.xml, LoggingDocsTest parses it and checks the LogcatAppender and the com.pubnub TRACE logger.
